artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 8.4 x 5.9 cm (3 5/16 x 2 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a writing desk. He is in profile, leaning forward with his right hand holding a pen and his left hand resting on the desk. The man has facial hair, a receding hairline, and short hair on top with a fuller back. He is draped with cloth, exposing his upper body and right leg. The desk is cluttered with papers, an open book, and an ink pot. A staff or pole leans against the desk. The background has linear textures, suggesting a wall or a partition.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Saint Elizabeth and Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brown wash, and white heightening on brown prepared laid paper; incised for transfer;  laid down
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a group of figures in an oval composition. At the center, a woman sits with a baby on her lap. The woman has delicate facial features, and her hair is styled in an intricate manner. She wears a voluminous garment that drapes over her body. To her left is a youthful figure kneeling with hands clasped around a staff. Behind her stands a bearded man looking on with an attentive expression. To the woman's right, another female figure is seated, leaning slightly forward with eyes directed at the baby. She wears a similar robed garment. In the foreground, a small lamb lies peacefully. The background features a lush landscape with a large tree offering shade, and distant hills are visible.

artworks.title: At Venice
artworks.medium: etching on thin laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water with a harbor in the distance. A large architectural building with columns and arches is on the left, with boats moored in front of it. The sky occupies the upper part of the image, and the water extends towards a vanishing point. Another boat and some structures can be seen in the background. The artwork is done with detailed etching, using fine lines to show textures and details. The color scheme is primarily black and white with subtle variations.

artworks.title: Hercules Resting from His Labors
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate (trimmed within bottom plate mark): 39.5 cm (15 9/16 in.)
sheet: 27.3 x 40.7 cm (10 3/4 x 16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth and Joseph Bromberg in memory of their son, Michael
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular male figure reclining in a natural setting. He is positioned in a relaxed posture, leaning back against a tree with his left arm resting on his leg, and his right hand holding a club. His face features a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, and a strong, square jaw adorned with a thick, curly beard and short, curly hair. He is unclothed, and a lion's skin is draped beside him, with the club resting on it. Surrounding him are lush plants, with trees framing the scene on either side. In the background is a detailed landscape with a town nestled between rolling hills and mountains. The town features various buildings, domes, and towers, as well as ships in the waterway. The sky is filled with stylized clouds.

artworks.title: Man Sitting on an Auricular Mask, Supporting a Strapwork Frame on his Shoulders
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum, after Cornelis Floris II
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image displays an intricate composition of curved lines and spirals forming a tree-like structure populated by various human figures and mythical creatures. The figures are arranged throughout the branches and base of the tree. familiar elements such as satyrs, serpents, and cherub-like children are intertwined with the flow of the tree's trunk and branches. Swirling shell forms and a central skeletal figure create a foundation at the base.

artworks.title: Autumn
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Hans Bol
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image depicts a bustling autumn scene with various figures engaged in tasks. A rustic building with a thatched roof is shown to the left, with a person leaning out from a window. The horizon, higher up in the image, showcases distant hills and a windmill. The artwork features detailed, linear engravings capturing textures of clothing, trees, and buildings. The color scheme is monochromatic using shades of brown and gray. In the distance, beyond the immediate scene, small cottages, a church with a tall spire, and a village nestled among trees can be seen in the rolling countryside.

artworks.title: Afternoon Tea Party
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint with touches of gold metallic paint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Two women with pale, peachy skin sit next to a table holding a tray and royal-blue tea cups and saucers in this colored, vertical etching and aquatint. Faint black lines outline the women, their features, clothing, and objects in the room, and each area is filled in with a flat color. The women face each other and take up most of the composition. Both have oval faces, rounded noses, pale, dusky pink lips, and their hair is pulled up and back. The woman to our right has brown hair and leans forward as she holds up a blue plate with her right hand, closer to us. The other hand rests on the arm of her tawny-brown chair. Her dress has a petal pink bodice and long skirt with fawn-brown long sleeves and fabric covering her chest and tucked into the low, rounded neckline. The other woman wears a blue cap over her black hair. The hat has a celery-green feather and is tied in a bow under the chin. She wears a hip-length, coffee bean-brown cloak over a pale, sage-green dress. She looks down at the plate and holds what might be a cookie or biscuit with one hand and a cup and a dish-like saucer with the other. Her lips are downturned and her head pulled slightly back to create a double chin. She sits upright in another brown chair. In the lower right corner of the sheet, the round dove-gray table is barely bigger than the round tawny-brown tray it holds. On it are two more cups and saucers and a silver jug, presumably holding milk. What might be another cup and saucer set or the teapot is cut off by the right edge of the paper. The rims of the cups and saucers are painted gold. A pale, barely mint-green screen with openings across the top stands to the left behind the second woman, and a window is behind the first. Spiky fronds of a houseplant angle up in front of sand-brown curtains covering the opening. A coral-pink curtain is pulled to the left side, and squiggles and flowers printed in darker tones of brown and pink respectively suggest patterns. The wall behind the screen is straw yellow. The artist signed and inscribed the sheet under the lower right corner, “Imprimée par l'artiste et M. Leroy, Mary Cassatt (25 épreuves) serie unique.” A tiny dark blue stamp with a short, wide C overlaid on a capital letter M is inked along the bottom edge of the image.

artworks.title: Woman Bathing
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: A pale-skinned woman bends over a basin of water on a washstand in this vertical, colored print. The woman is angled away from us so only her ear and the curve of her forehead are visible beyond her hunched shoulder. Her upper body is bare, her dress having been unfastened so it hangs around her waist. The dress is striped with grass green, rose pink, and the cream white of the paper. Light gleams on her auburn hair, which is tied up and back. She cups her hands in the light blue water of the faintly yellow basin. Two bottles sit at the back corner of the washstand, and a mirror reflects the top of her head. The fawn-brown washstand is boxy, and a handled white pitcher painted with muted pink flowers is at the front left corner, which is closest to us. The wall beyond the washstand is marine blue, and the floor is brighter sapphire blue with a pattern of celery-green leaves. A mark with an oval, or a mirrored C, over an uppercase M, is stamped in royal blue at the bottom center of the print. The sheet is inscribed with graphite across the right half of the bottom margin, “Imprimée par l'artiste et M. Leroy Mary Cassatt.”

artworks.title: The Fitting
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows two women in a private indoor setting. One woman is standing in front of a mirror adjusting her dress, while the other woman is seated nearby, looking at her. The standing woman has dark hair styled in an updo and is wearing a long, striped dress. She has a contemplative expression with closed eyes. The seated woman is wearing a dark brown garment and is facing the standing woman. The background includes yellow-green patterned wallpaper and a similarly designed floor.

artworks.title: Fairy Connoisseurs Inspecting Mr. Frederick Locker's Collection of Drawings
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is an illustration of fairy characters gathered in an art salon. The room is filled with various artworks and frames attributed to famous artists like Raphael and Van Dyck. The detailed drawing shows small fairies examining and interacting with the art pieces, which are oversized compared to them. The fairies are depicted engaging with the artworks in various ways. The room also features a detailed chandelier hanging from the ceiling. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of narrative illustrations, inviting viewers to explore the tiny world depicted.

artworks.title: Fairy Connoisseurs Inspecting Mr. Frederick Locker's Collection of Drawings
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 25.7 x 17.3 cm (10 1/8 x 6 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of fairies in an interior gallery. The fairies are interacting with a collection of drawings and paintings by various famous artists. The room is decorated with frames, a chandelier, and various artworks displayed on walls and a table. The fairies appear to be critiquing and discussing the artworks. The drawing is detailed and conveys a playful and whimsical feel through the fairies' postures and gestures.

artworks.title: Fantastic Vases
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image depicts several large decorative vases with intricate floral arrangements. The vases are designed in black and white, resembling etched prints. The first vase on the left has horse heads and a profusion of flowers. The second vase has ornate handles and is filled with roses. The central vase is larger with a face at its center and etched text on its surface. The vases on the right have elaborate bouquets and a coiled motif around a face with floral elements. The objects are displayed in a row at the bottom of the frame against a plain background.

artworks.title: Fantastic Vases
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image displays a variety of ornately designed vases and large planters, each containing dense arrangements of flowers and plant life, set against a plain background. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring shades of black and white. The largest container, located in the middle of the composition, features figures around its base and is surrounded by other decorative vases with intricate detailing and floral arrangements on either side. To the right, a vase adorned with ram’s heads is present, and to the left, a vase depicting a mythological scene is evident.

artworks.title: Fantastic Vases
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows a series of ornate vases with intricate carvings and filled with floral arrangements. The vases are designed in black and white, with different designs. From left to right, there is a vase with a dragon handle, a large vase with cherubs supporting it, and another vase with flowers coming out of it. The vases and flowers are arranged closely next to each other in a horizontal line.

artworks.title: Fantastic Vases
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows several intricately designed vases arranged in a line, each filled with different types of floral arrangements. The color palette is monochrome, consisting solely of black and white etching lines. There are two large vases on each end and three smaller vases, including a central one with a sculpted figure, placed between them. Each vase displays ornate details and intricate decoration, with flowers extending upwards from their openings.

artworks.title: Landscape with High Cliffs, River, and City
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 14.3 x 21.5 cm (5 5/8 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a landscape with castles, houses, and hills viewed from an elevated perspective. There is a castle on a hilltop at the center. The etching features fine linework and intricate details. It is monochromatic, using shades of black on cream-colored paper. A castle is on the left, another in the middle distance to the right. A large tree is on the right. Various buildings, hills, and a river extend into the background.

artworks.title: Marie-Rosalie Vanloo
artworks.artist: Louis-Marin Bonnet after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black and white on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a young child in profile view. The child has a delicate face, with a smooth forehead, a small nose, and slightly upturned lips. The hair is styled in waves and curls, tied back with a decorative bow or hairpiece. The child is wearing a garment with a ruffled neckline. The background is a textured, dark surface.

artworks.title: Seated Cavalier with His Arm Akimbo
artworks.medium: black chalk and brush and black ink with white heightening on blue paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a seated person from the waist up. The individual is turned slightly to the side with hands resting in their lap. They have long, wavy hair, wear a wide-brimmed hat, and exhibit a slight smile. The person is depicted wearing a coat or jacket with button details and slightly puffed sleeves. No jewelry is visible. The background is a blank blue canvas, and there is a border framing the image.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Waterfall
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a body of water flowing towards a rocky landscape. In the background, there are mountains, trees, and a cascading waterfall. The artwork is created with detailed brown ink lines, capturing motion and texture. In the foreground, a figure is bending over rocks in the water, while another figure walks along the water carrying a stick and a bundle. Further back, people are seen standing on rock formations. The color palette is monochrome with sepia tones, emphasizing the intricate line work and the landscape's grandeur.

artworks.title: Spotted Bull and Three Sheep
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 13.9 x 16.5 cm (5 1/2 x 6 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features a pastoral scene with animals depicted in a detailed and intricate style through fine line work typical of etching. The scene includes cows grazing and a sheep lying down, set against a background of foliage and distant trees, all in a monochrome color palette of black and white that emphasizes light and shadow contrasts.

artworks.title: A Loch in Scotland
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 48.5 x 78.5 cm (19 1/8 x 30 7/8 in.)
overall (mat size): 66 x 94 cm (26 x 37 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund

artworks.title: Ladies and Gentlemen in a Country Park
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in a park-like setting engaged in leisure activities. The drawing captures several figures adorned in clothing indicative of the 18th century. On the left side, a cluster of individuals stand together; one figure holds a parasol. Adjacent to them sits a dog. On the right side, some individuals are seated or standing. The background includes sketching of clouds and vegetation, reinforcing the outdoor setting. The drawing's soft lines and minimal detail suggest a focus on human interaction and social camaraderie in a relaxed outdoor environment.

artworks.title: A Young Man with Flowing Hair
artworks.medium: red and brown chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a detailed drawing of a person from the shoulders up, capturing their head and face prominently. The person is in a semi-profile view, with their head slightly turned to the side and their gaze directed upward. The individual has distinct facial features, including a strong jawline and slightly parted lips. Their hair is voluminous and wavy, cascading around their head with loose curls. The person is wearing a garment with a high, ruffled collar. The drawing is rendered in shades of brown, with fine lines and shading. The background is a plain, uncluttered surface.

artworks.title: Saint Anthony of Padua
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a figure from the waist up, facing slightly to the viewer's left. The person is depicted in a contemplative pose, gazing down at a book held open in front of them with both hands. The facial features show a serene expression with a straight nose and closed mouth. The person has short, wavy hair with a slight fringe. They are wearing a loose, flowing robe or tunic with a large hood that rests on the shoulders. Draped over the shoulders is a thin stem with leaves and flowers. A long beaded rosary or set of prayer beads hangs from one wrist. In the background is a simple, line-etched sky with a few wispy clouds and faint outlines of a building or architectural feature to the left.
